title: EvaluatorOutput
description: Final evaluator output for the Vocabulary Complexity evaluator (shared by both the grades-3-4 and other-grades branches). Enforced via structured output at the model call boundary -- other-grades' system.txt prose ("provide an answer... use only a single integer") describes a different, narrower contract than this schema requires. That mismatch is pre-existing and intentionally left in the prompt text; see the vocab_complexity_other_grades step's description in config.json.

tier_2_words.description: List of Tier 2 words: words commonly used in academic settings, more complex than colloquial or everyday language, often with multiple meanings.

tier_3_words.description: List of Tier 3 words: overly academic or domain-specific words.

archaic_words.description: List of archaic words, or common words used in an archaic way, not commonly used in modern conversational language.

other_complex_words.description: All other words that can increase complexity of the text (e.g., idioms, unfamiliar proper nouns that function as vocabulary).

complexity_score.description: The vocabulary complexity level of the text.

reasoning.description: A detailed explanation of the rating. Grades 3-4 reference density and cumulative effect, contextual scaffolding, abstract vs. concrete vocabulary, conceptual load, and the provided student background knowledge; other grades reference the annotation guide and rubric.
